labs.title: Mathematical language, proofs, and linear algebra

challenges: Derive the null vector before running: the last column is 2*x0-3*x1.
Replace a pivot with a nearly dependent value and study tolerance sensitivity.

challenges: Derive the squared-distance triangle-inequality counterexample.
Scale only one feature and predict its effect on neighbors.
Check translation invariance without refitting unrelated preprocessing.

labs.gate: Give a map that loses information and explain which.

labs.native_parity: Go/Rust numerical or exact common-protocol comparison

challenges: Explain why there are eight subsets before enumerating candidate families.
Construct a projection that is not injective.
Prove the inverse-image intersection identity without relying on a finite test.

labs.title: Surfaces, simplices, triangulations, and pixel geometry

challenges: Remove a required face and predict the validation error.
Explain how adding a triangular face changes H1.
